## What's new

### Tafsir and offline reading
- **Read tafsir verse by verse.** Choose a commentary edition beside the translation, or keep it matched to the translation language. Each verse has its own toggle, so you can open commentary only where you want it.
- **Save tafsir for offline use.** The Offline manager now includes audio and tafsir, with edition and surah controls for downloading and deleting saved content.
- **Bengali is ready out of the box.** Noto Sans Bengali is bundled with the app, so Bengali translations and tafsir display even when the system has no Bengali font installed.
- **Adjust tafsir text size** in Settings.

### Improvements
- Network failures while loading audio, translations, or tafsir now offer a retry action.
- The verse-by-verse tafsir controls and Offline manager have been refined for clearer layout and theme consistency.
- Website updates improve the step-section scrolling, the return-to-top button, and search indexing metadata.
